title: Primal-dual dynamics featuring Hessian-driven damping and variable mass for convex optimization problems
summary: This paper deals with a new Tikhonov regularized primal-dual dynamical system with variable mass and Hessian-driven damping for solving a convex optimization problem with linear equality constraints. The system features several time-dependent parameters: variable mass, slow viscous damping, extrapolation, and temporal scaling.
